whatThisIs: Compare the allowed amount on each 835 service line with the contract rate you supply. The remittance allowed amount is the billed charge minus CO adjustments; modifier-specific fee rows take precedence over a code-only rate.
whenToUse: Use this before a payment dispute when the payer may have allowed less than the contracted fee. The tool ships no payer rates and makes no assumptions about contract terms you did not enter.
inputs: One or more X12 835 files and a CSV or TSV fee schedule. Each fee row has a billing code, optional modifier, and either a contracted amount or a reference amount with a contract percentage.
output: Underpaid service lines, dollar variance, totals by payer and billing code, unmatched-line count, and full or patient-redacted dispute CSVs.

rows: $150.00 on one line and $149.99 on another
example.result: 1 of 2 matched lines was paid below contract, totaling $0.01.
